meta.name: Importers
meta.about: Every way content gets into HAX: 12 platform importers, 5 file formats that become a site, and what the editor accepts dropped or pasted into a page. Generated from haxcms-nodejs and the site editor.

kindLabels.rel: way in to source; entry point to way in

w_platform.desc: Point HAXcms at a site elsewhere and it becomes a new HAX site: one importer per platform, all behind site/import/{platform}.

w_file.desc: Upload a document and its structure becomes pages: headings in Word, slides in PowerPoint, rows in Excel.

w_page.desc: While editing, drop a file or paste a link; the editor converts it and places it where you are.

p_wordpress.desc: Pages and posts from a WordPress site, through its REST API. Import a WordPress site as a new site

p_drupal.desc: Nodes from a Drupal site; the platform ELMS:LN and much of HAX's history were built on. Import a Drupal site as a new site

p_plone.desc: Content from a Plone site. Import a Plone site as a new site

p_elmsln.desc: Courses from an ELMS:LN network, the system HAXcms grew out of. Import an ELMSLN site as a new site

p_haxcms.desc: Another HAXcms site or export: site.json plus pages, the same files a skeleton ships as. Import a HAXcms site as a new site

p_notion.desc: A Notion export or workspace tree. Import a Notion site as a new site

p_gitbook.desc: A GitBook documentation site, from its summary and markdown. Import a GitBook site as a new site

p_vitepress.desc: A VitePress documentation site, from its config and markdown. Import a VitePress documentation site as a new site

p_quarto.desc: A Quarto book or website project. Import a Quarto project (book or website) as a new site

p_pressbooks.desc: An open textbook from Pressbooks. Import a Pressbooks site as a new site

p_openstax.desc: An OpenStax textbook; the openstax2hax plugin prepares the book for conversion. Import an OpenStax textbook as a new site

p_html.desc: A plain HTML page or site, crawled from a URL. Import an HTML page or site as a new site

f_docx.desc: Word documents (.docx, .doc). Headings become pages when you import as a site; drop one into a page to insert its content. Drop it in the editor to insert as HTML, or create sibling or child pages from its headings.
f_docx.note: Site import: POST /system/api/v1/actions/import-docx. Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_pptx.desc: PowerPoint files (.pptx). Each slide can become a page. Drop it in the editor: one page per slide, or inserted as HTML.
f_pptx.note: Site import: POST /system/api/v1/actions/import-pptx. Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_pdf.desc: PDF files, converted to semantic HTML. Drop it in the editor to insert as semantic HTML, or embed the PDF in the page.
f_pdf.note: Site import: POST /system/api/v1/actions/import-pdf. Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_xlsx.desc: Spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xls, .ods). Rows become pages when imported as a site, or a table inside a page. Drop it in the editor to insert as an editable table, or convert to CSV.
f_xlsx.note: Site import: POST /system/api/v1/actions/import-xlsx. Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_html.desc: HTML files and pages. Drop or paste HTML into the editor.
f_html.note: Site import: POST /system/api/v1/actions/import-html. Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_md.desc: Markdown and plain text, converted to HTML on the way in. Drop a .md or .txt file in the editor; it is converted to HTML.
f_md.note: Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_media.desc: Media files become media-image, audio-player or video-player blocks, uploaded to the site's files folder. Drop or paste a file; it is uploaded to files/ and placed as the right block.
f_media.note: Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_url.desc: Any link: YouTube, Vimeo, Wikipedia and other sources the app store knows become embeds; other pages become link cards. Paste a link into the editor or Merlin: the page's metadata is read and it is embedded or linked.
f_url.note: Page import: handled by the site editor.

f_jos.desc: An item export in JSON Outline Schema, imported with hax site site:items-import.

dashboard.note: Create a site: pick Import and choose a platform or a file.

editor.note: Drop a file or paste a URL while editing.

merlin.note: Import from a URL, or drop a file on the top bar.

cli.note: hax site --import-site <url> --import-structure <platform>, and site:items-import for JOS items.

tag_actions.desc: The converter and import actions in the OpenAPI system spec.

tours.label: Get your content in
tours.message: Three ways in: a whole site from another platform, a site from one file, or content dropped into the page you are writing.

scenes.caption: Everything you already have can come into HAX.
From documentation tools and textbook publishers.
From one file: Word headings, PowerPoint slides or Excel rows become pages.
Into the page you are writing: drop a document, a spreadsheet, media, or paste a link.
Start from the dashboard, the editor, Merlin, the CLI or the MCP; the same OpenAPI actions do the work.
